analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI is exiting oversold territory and settling into neutral. MACD histogram turned positive from negative, showing improvement. The 5-day low of 95,920 is higher than the 20-day low of 82,500, initiating a Higher Low pattern. Volume is at average levels, indicating a lack of conviction. Weekly ADX at 41.7 suggests a clear trend, but daily action lacks direction.
